title: Sebenza Tracks Schema
description: JSON schema for project-level track registry with kanban board support

path.description: Absolute path to project root — the working root this workspace lives in (git rev-parse --show-toplevel)

worktree.description: Worktree identifier when this workspace is a linked git worktree; absent in the main checkout

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the main checkout root when this workspace is a linked git worktree; absent in the main checkout

registered_at.description: When project was registered with sebenza

track_status.description: Overall track status for kanban board

origin.description: The Sebenza inbox item this track was started from and the worktree working on it. Display-only for the graph view; written once at registration from .ai/sebenza/inbox-origin.json.

worktree.description: Worktree identifier (directory name), never a path

current_phase_id.description: Id of the phase in progress: the first phase that is not done. Kept current by sebenza-implement.

design_path.description: Path to design.md relative to the workspace dir (.ai/sebenza/) holding this tracks.json — NOT to the project root. Always './tracks/<track_id>/design.md'. Present once the Design stage has run; features are designed before spec/plan exist.

plan_path.description: Path to plan.json relative to the workspace dir (.ai/sebenza/) holding this tracks.json — NOT to the project root. Always './tracks/<track_id>/plan.json'. Present once the plan has been generated.

spec_path.description: Path to spec.md relative to the workspace dir (.ai/sebenza/) holding this tracks.json — NOT to the project root. Always './tracks/<track_id>/spec.md'. Present once the spec has been generated.

test_plan_path.description: Path to test-plan.md relative to the workspace dir (.ai/sebenza/) holding this tracks.json — NOT to the project root. Always './tracks/<track_id>/test-plan.md'. Present once the test plan has been written — by the Design stage for features, by the Plan stage otherwise.

phases_summary.description: Summary of phases for kanban cards

request.description: The Sebenza inbox request raised for this item while it is blocked, written only by scripts/inbox.py. The graph view reads it.

request_id.description: The daemon's requestId, or null when it could not be looked up or the request is unsent

status.description: open: waiting on the operator; unsent: kept locally because the daemon was unreachable or refused it; resolved: the operator answered
